title: Bourgain-Ruzsa Type Estimates for the Maximum and Minimum of Littlewood Cosine polynomials on the Real Line
summary: We prove that $$\max_{t \in {\Bbb R}}{T_n(t)} \geq \frac{1}{60}n^{1/3} \qquad \text {and} \qquad -\min_{t \in {\Bbb R}}{T_n(t)} \geq \frac{1}{60}n^{1/3}$$ for every trigonometric polynomial $T_n$ of the form $$T_n(t) = \sum_{j=1}^n{\cos(jt-θ_j)}\,, \quad θ_j \in {\Bbb R}\,, \quad t \in {\Bbb R}\,.$$
